paite: Huchi in Pathian bawm ahon lalut ua, David in abawlsak, puanin laizang ah akoihta ua, Pathian ma ah halmang thillatte leh lemna thillatte alan uhi.
heading: David In Pathian Bawm Laklutna

paite: David in halmang thillat leh lemna thillatte alat khit in TOUPA min in mite avualzawl hi.
Israel michih kiang ah, pasal leh numei michih kiang ah tanghou beu khat, sa bak khat leh grep min gaw beu khat ahawm hi.
Huchi in TOUPA bawm mai a nasem ding leh TOUPA, Israel' Pathian kipahpih ding, kipahthu gen ding leh phat ding in Levi mite lak a kuate hiam asepta hi:
Amakai lianpen Asaph, amah zom in Zekariah, Shemiramoth, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, pekging gui sawm neite leh kaihgingte toh; Asaph dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ging toh;
Benaiah leh Jahaziel siampute Pathian thukhun bawm ma a, om nilouhte toh.
Huchi in huai ni in David in, Asaph leh a-unaute khut ah, TOUPA kiang a kipahthute gen ding ahihkip masa penpen hi.
Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthute gen unla, amin lou un; mite lak ah athilhihte theisak un.
heading: David Kipahthu Genna Phatna La / (Sam 105.1-15; 96.1-13; 106.1,47,48)

paite: Amah mai ah la sa unla, phatna late sa un; anasep lamdangte tengteng thu in houlim un.
Amin siangthou suang unla: TOUPA zongte lungtang kipak hen.
TOUPA leh ahatna zong unla; amel zong nilouh un.
Ahih khitsa athillamdangte theigige unla; alamdannate leh, akam a vaihawmte;
Aw nou asikha Israel chi, nou amitel, Jakob tate.
Amah TOUPA i Pathian ahi: ama'n leitung pumpi vai ahawm hi.
Tangtawn in athukhun theigige unla, suan sangkhatte kiang a apiak athu;
Thukhun Abraham toh abawl, Isak kiang a athuchiam;
Huai mah dan thuseh ding in Jakob kiang ah ahihkip a, Israel kiang ah tangtawn thukhun ding in;
"Na kiang ah Kanaan gam, na goutan tuan, ka hon pe ding," chi in;
Mi tawmchik phet na hih lai un; ahi, tawmchik mahmah, asung a mikhual in;
Nam dangdang kiang ah abanhoh ua, gam dangdang a kipan in mi tuamtuamte kiang ah.
Kuamah nuaisiah aphal kei a; ahi, amaute ziak in kumpipate leng asal hi;
"Ka thaunilhte khoih kei unla, ka zawlneite leng hihna kei un," chi in.
Leitung luahte tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la sa unla, niteng in ahotdamna thu theisak un.
Namte lak ah athupidan gen unla, michihte lak ah athilhih lamdangte genzak un.
TOUPA lah athupi a, nakpi mahmah a phat ding ahih ziak in pathian tengteng sang a kihtak ding ahi.
Michih pathiante milim ahi ua; TOUPA'N bel vante abawl hi.
Pahtawina leh thupina ama ah a-om a; hatna leh kilawmna ama mun ah a-om hi.
Michih a chichihte aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA thupina leh hatna pia un.
TOUPA amin thupina pia unla, thillat ding tawi unla, ama ah hong pai un; siangthou kilawmna in TOUPA bia un.
Leitung tengteng aw, ama ah ling un; khovel leng alin theihlouhna ding in hihkip in a-om hi.
Vante kipaktak in om uhenla, leitung leng nuamsatak in om hen; namte lak ah "TOUPA'N vai ahawm," chi uhen.
Tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng ging honhon henla; gam leh asung a om tengteng kipaktak in om hen;
Huai hun chiang in gamnuai a sing tengteng in TOUPA ma ah nuamsa in la asa ding ua, leitung vaihawm ding in ahong pai sin ngal a.
Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un, amah lah ahoih ngal a; achitna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
"Aw, ka hotdamna uh Pathian, hon hondam inla, na min siangthou phat ding leh na phatna suang ding in, namte lak a kipan hon pikhawm inla, hon humbit in," chi un.
Israel' Pathian TOUPA phat in om hen, tangtawn a kipan tangtawn dong in. Mipi tengteng in, Amen, chi in TOUPA aphatta uhi.
Huchi in huai a TOUPA thukhun bawm ma a niteng a akuldan bang zel a nasem ding in Asaph leh a- unaute akoihta a;
heading: Jerusalem Leh Gibeon A Biakna

paite: Obed-edom leh a-unau uh sawmguk-le-giatte toh; Jeduthun tapa Obed-edom leh Hosah bel kongkhak ngakmi ahi uhi;
Huan Zadok siampu leh a-unaute siampute, Gibeon a om mun sang a TOUPA biakbuk ma a,
zingsang leh nitak a halmang thillat maitam tung a TOUPA a dia halmang thillatte lan gige ding in, Israel kiang ah thupiak a piak TOUPA, dan sung a kigelh dungzui in;
Azahngaihna tangtawn a a-om ziak in TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen ding Heman leh Jeduthun leh midang min loh a telkhiakte toh;
Heman leh Jeduthun in Pathian lasakna dia vanzatte, pengkulte leh dakkhutbette, ngaihtak a ginsak dingte anei ua; kongkhak ngakmi ding Jeduthun tapate toh.
Huchi in mipi tengteng amau inn lam chiat ah apaita ua; huan David leng a-inkote vualzawl ding in apai sam hi.
